explain.vi: Tumang là cha ruột của Sangkuriang, bị biến thành chó.
explain.en: Tumang was Sangkuriang's real father, turned into a dog.
explain.zh-Hans: 图曼是桑库里昂被变成狗的亲生父亲。
explain.tl: Si Tumang ang tunay na ama.
explain.my: တူမန်က သူ့ အဖေအရင်း။
explain.th: ตูมังคือพ่อแท้ๆ

choices: 頭の大きなきずを見たから

explain.vi: Bà thấy vết sẹo do chính mình đánh năm xưa.
explain.en: She saw the scar from the blow she gave him long ago.
explain.zh-Hans: 她看到了当年自己打出的伤疤。
explain.my: အမာရွတ်ကို မြင်လို့။
explain.th: เห็นแผลเป็น

explain.vi: Tiếng giã gạo và vải trắng làm gà tưởng trời đã sáng.
explain.en: The rice pounding and white cloths made them think it was dawn.
explain.zh-Hans: 舂米声和白布让鸡以为天亮了。
explain.ko: 쌀 찧는 소리와 흰 천 때문에 아침인 줄 알았다.
explain.tl: Akala nila umaga na dahil sa pagbabayo.
explain.ne: धान कुटेको आवाजले बिहान भयो ठाने।
explain.id: Suara tumbukan padi membuat mereka mengira pagi.
explain.pt: O pilão os fez pensar que era manhã.
explain.my: ဆန်ထောင်းသံကြောင့် မိုးလင်းပြီ ထင်တယ်။
explain.th: เสียงตำข้าวทำให้คิดว่าเช้าแล้ว

quiz.ja: 男鹿半島の話で、鬼たちが作った石段は、何段？

explain.vi: Chỉ còn thiếu một bậc là đủ nghìn — 999 bậc vẫn còn đến nay.
explain.en: One short of a thousand—the 999 steps remain today.
explain.zh-Hans: 差一级满一千——九百九十九级至今还在。
explain.ko: 천 개에서 하나 모자란 999개가 지금도 남아 있다.
explain.tl: 999, kulang ng isa sa isang libo.
explain.my: ၉၉၉ ထစ်၊ တစ်ထောင်မှာ တစ်ထစ် လို။
explain.th: 999 ขั้น ขาดหนึ่งขั้นจะครบพัน
